method: Source review only (evidence tier 3 for transcribed literals, tier 4 for independently derived values). No C++ was built or executed and no prebuilt reference output exercises this header. Expected values are either transcribed from the pinned MathFunctions_test.cpp or computed independently from a closed form, an exact rational evaluation or an algebraic invariant; tests/math_functions.rs labels each assertion with which of the two it is.

source_files.role: The ported header. Header-only: every member is an inline definition or a template, so this file is both interface and implementation.
The header's paired translation unit. It opens and closes namespace OpenMS and defines nothing; hashed so that a later revision adding a definition here is visible.
The oracle. 16 START_SECTION blocks; every transcribed literal in tests/math_functions.rs comes from this file. Nine public members have no section here at all.
Not ported here. Read for RangeBase's constructor, isEmpty, contains, setMin, setMax and extendLeftRight, which are the behaviours createBins depends on and which the native Bin type reproduces.
Not ported here. Read for Exception::InvalidValue and Exception::InvalidParameter, which percentOf and quantile throw.
Not ported here. Read for OPENMS_PRECONDITION, which zoomIn and createBins use and which is compiled out of release builds.
Not ported here. Read for UInt, which isOdd takes.
Not ported here. Read for StringUtils::toStr, which percentOf uses only to build its exception message.

source_anchors.operation: zoomIn computes (1.0f - factor) as a single-precision subtraction before widening, because factor and align are float; the port keeps f32 parameters so the low bit matches
createBins sizes std::vector<RangeBase> res directly from the caller's number_of_bins with no ceiling; the port preflights against MAX_BINS before allocating
res.front().setMin(min) and res.back().setMax(max) run unconditionally; with OPENMS_PRECONDITION compiled out, number_of_bins == 0 makes both calls undefined behaviour on an empty vector
res[i].extendLeftRight(extend_margin) is a no-op on an already empty range and can itself make a bin empty for a negative margin; both are reproduced by Bin::is_empty
ceilDecimal scales with pow(10.0, decPow), an int promoted to double, so std::pow(double,double) is selected; the port uses f64::powf, not powi
roundDecimal takes the negating branch for x == 0 because zero is not > 0, so roundDecimal(0.0, p) is negative zero; reproduced rather than normalised
intervalTransformation divides by right1 - left1 with no check and multiplies before dividing; the order is preserved and the zero span is now an error
linear2log calls log10(x + 1) unguarded, giving -inf at x == -1 and NaN below; the port refuses instead
roundTo builds its scaling factor by repeated multiplication or division by ten rather than by pow, which is a different double; the loop is transcribed literally and bounded by MAX_DECIMAL_DIGITS
percentOf compares total <= 0 rather than == 0 to avoid a float equality test, and returns 0.0 instead of dividing
gcd evaluates a % b with no overflow check; INT_MIN % -1 is undefined behaviour and traps on x86. The port uses checked_rem
the extended gcd evaluates u3 / v3 and u - v * q unchecked; the port checks every division, multiplication and subtraction
getPPM divides by mz_ref, the reference, never by the observed value; the conversion is therefore not antisymmetric in its arguments and a swapped call site is a silent mass-dependent error
ppmToMass divides by 1e6 before multiplying by mz_ref; the order is preserved because the regrouped expression rounds differently
ppmToMassAbs's documentation block opens with /* instead of /**, so the member is missing from generated Doxygen; its content is carried into the rustdoc regardless
getTolWindow's ppm right edge is val / (1 - tol*1e-6), not val * (1 + tol*1e-6), which makes the window asymmetric on purpose and divides by zero at tol == 1e6
quantile's index is max(0., n*q - 1), not (n-1)*q, so the median of a five-element sample is the midpoint of the second and third values; sortedness is stated in the @brief and never checked
log_binomial_coef replaces k with n - k when k > n / 2 using integer division, before the log-gammas, which makes C(n,k) and C(n,n-k) bit-identical

log_sum_exp selects its maximum with std::max, which returns its first argument when the comparison is false and so propagates a NaN x; f64::max would discard it. Positive infinity is not guarded and yields NaN
binomial_cdf_complement's range test p < 0.0 || p > 1.0 is false for a NaN, which then reaches Boost's distribution constructor; the port refuses a non-finite p

the tail is Boost's regularized incomplete beta function via cdf(complement(binomial_distribution(N,p), n-1)); the port sums the probability-mass definition in the log domain instead, because Boost is not a dependency and none may be added. Agreement against an exact rational oracle is within 2.5e-14 relative over every case in the class test
log_binomial_coef and binomial_cdf_complement throw std::invalid_argument, not an OpenMS exception, so a caller catching Exception::BaseException misses them

class_test_review.literal_extraction: Every TEST_REAL_SIMILAR / TEST_TRUE / TEST_FALSE / TEST_EXCEPTION expectation in the 16 sections is reproduced in tests/math_functions.rs, with the source's default TOLERANCE_RELATIVE(1.0 + 1e-5) unless the value is exactly representable, in which case equality is asserted.

independent_oracles: binomial_cdf_complement against an exact rational evaluation of the same probability-mass sum (Python fractions.Fraction with math.comb); maximum relative deviation 2.5e-14 over the nine numeric cases in the class test
log_binomial_coef against ln(252) and ln(184756), the closed forms of C(10,5) and C(20,10)
log_sum_exp(x, x) == x + ln 2 as an exact identity
the ppm round trip ppm(mz_ref + ppm_to_mass(t, mz_ref), mz_ref) == t
the zoomIn round trip from the header's own @code block
create_bins adjacency, union and 2*margin overlap invariants
the Bezout identity a*u1 + b*u2 == gcd for five argument pairs
endpoint invariance of interval_transformation for arbitrary spans
native_boundaries: MAX_BINS bounds create_bins before the vector is allocated
MAX_BINOMIAL_TRIALS bounds the binomial tail sum before its term vector is allocated
MAX_DECIMAL_DIGITS bounds round_to's factor loop, which the source will run |INT_MIN| times
every division by a caller-controlled denominator is checked; every logarithm argument is checked
quantile checks ascending order and returns Error::UnsortedData
both gcd overloads check integer overflow
no unsafe, no threads; the header carries no #pragma omp so there is no parallelism gap to record
